component.name: TeX Viewer
component.summary: Write LaTeX and see the page as it will print

description.p: A desktop LaTeX editor with a split view: your source on the left, the rendered document on the right.

ul.li: Live — an instant rendering of a useful subset of LaTeX, with maths typeset by KaTeX. It updates as you type and needs no compiler.
PDF — the genuine article, produced by running a real LaTeX engine over the document and rasterising the result.

description.p: Both modes render on the same sheet, in Latin Modern — the typeface pdflatex itself sets — at the same measure, so switching between them compares one document two ways rather than swapping it for a differently-styled web page.

A Tectonic engine is bundled, so PDF compilation works without installing a TeX distribution first; an existing pdflatex, xelatex or lualatex is preferred when one is present. The first compile with the bundled engine downloads the support files the document needs and caches them.
